tables.name: bim_adjacency
sample_queries: SELECT source_object_id, COUNT(*) AS degree FROM bim_adjacency   GROUP BY source_object_id ORDER BY degree DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT relation_type, COUNT(*) FROM bim_adjacency GROUP BY relation_type;

tables.name: bim_objects
sample_queries: SELECT refined_class, COUNT(*) FROM bim_objects GROUP BY refined_class ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT * FROM bim_objects WHERE pipeline = 'P-10147' AND is_container = 0;
SELECT pipeline, COUNT(*) AS objects, SUM(dry_weight_kg) AS total_kg   FROM bim_objects WHERE refined_class='PipingComponent'   GROUP BY pipeline ORDER BY total_kg DESC LIMIT 20;

tables.name: bim_objects_fts
sample_queries: SELECT object_id, display_name FROM bim_objects_fts   WHERE bim_objects_fts MATCH 'pump' LIMIT 20;
